texts: Tumours of the diaphragm are rare, and most of them are secondary, from neighbouring organs or metastases.
Most primary diaphragmatic tumours are benign, such as lipomas and cysts, not malignant.
The majority are discovered in the fifth to seventh decade of life: B is the answer.
Memory hook: the butter lump is found by grey-haired sailors wearing the signs 50 and 70.
